name: Capstone: study-room finder
scope: A web app that shows which campus study rooms are free right now and links out to book one. Three of us, one semester.
goal: A working demo at the midterm, a pilot with ten classmates by the final.

priority_why: Two teammates are blocked now and the demo is within 7 days.
